illustration: A monochrome pixel-like motif: rounded black squares stepping diagonally across a faint grid, with one inverted block where white circles sit on a white field. No figure, no text — the grid and the stepped silhouette are the whole image.

effects.description: Rounded squares on a regular grid, arranged as a diagonal cluster; one block inverts to white circles on white.
A hairline grid over the whole canvas, one cell per module, barely lighter than the ground.

hierarchy: one inverted white block of circles
